items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: My family was musical. In fact they told me that two weeks before I was born they got front row seats to a concert by Artie Shaw.

ctx.x: Where did you get the music in New Zealand. Do they have decent record stores and so forth? Was your family musical?

My family was musical. In fact they told me that two weeks before I was born they got front row seats to a concert by Artie Shaw. And so they used to take me all kinds of places before I was born, so I was absorbing Artie Shaw at the time. And so they had a huge record collection. There was Artie Shaw and Woody — in fact my parents were just blown away when I got the job with Woody.
